sourceArgument: Actual psElabTypedBinders starts at psElabContextEmpty/psLocalEmpty, pushes original binders in source order and returns a local nextId above every original parameter ID. Its temporary elaboration scopes are restored; name/type/kind associations remain in the returned original binder list.

BuildNormalizationWithOrigin is the sole non-recursive code caller of RenameParameters in the reviewed path. It now begins the syntax-only parameter-domain walk with the full original binderResult.localContext.nextId but an empty declaration list.

Each recursive RenameParameters step prepends the identical actual original binder ID/name/type/kind in identical order, while preserving that reserved nextId. Only preceding original declarations are visible to each domain.

psElabRecursionPushName allocates dummy syntax-shadow IDs at or above the reserved high-water mark. Thus none belongs to plan.parameterIds. Nesting increments locally; temporary sibling contexts may reuse dummy IDs harmlessly because each is discarded.

Exact full-name, first-segment and proper-local-prefix resolution examine the same declaration names in the same order and the same environment. Original parameter IDs do not change. Ordinary local-domain reference selection therefore does not change, and a dummy ID can no longer be mistaken for a current or future parameter ID.

Domains with no local syntax binder, including no-generic constant Nat domains, produce identical rewritten syntax. Existing type-parameter references preserve their original IDs. Body/result traversal keeps its original complete local context. Fixed/state selection, runtime/domain checks, worker/public construction and origins are unchanged.
The helper's strengthened precondition is for the actual caller; arbitrary external calls supplying psLocalEmpty with unrelated nonempty typed/plan inputs are not covered.

def f (n : Nat) (x : (fun (T : Type) => T) Nat) : Nat :=
  match n with
  | Nat.zero => x
  | Nat.succ k => f k (Nat.add x 1)
finding.oldPath: n=0,x=1; walking x's domain under prefix n starts dummy T at ID1; reference T is wrongly renamed as $psc0SH.1 while its binder remains T; predicted worker-domain refusal.
finding.scope: The example identifies an existing syntax-walk association error. It is not evidence that every general type-expression form is mandatory under SPEC or that an incorrect program was accepted.
